newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka stocks close higher for second day.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka stocks close higher for second day.

text.p: Sri Lanka stocks closed slightly hihgre for the second consecutive day on Thursday, but brokers said overall sentiment was dull with investors marking time till the new year.
The all share index closed one point higher at 592.4, up again after falling steadily in the past week.
"But the market was hanging. There was no major investor interest," a broker for Bartleet Mallory said.
Turnover, supported mainly by 198,300 shares of Walkers Tours at 11 rupees and 22,000 Tea Small Holder at 25 rupees, was 13.3 million rupees on 752,892 shares.
Blue chips Aitken Spence and Hayleys were up 9.75 and 2 rupees respectively. Conglomerate John Keells Holdings was down 1.75 to 190 rupees.
On Wednesday, the all share closed 1.25 points higher at 591.22 on a turnover of 49.1 million rupees.
Brokers said many people would wait for the year to end, and start the new year aggressively.
"All indications are that the market is due for a good upturn next year," said Namal Kamalgoda of CTC Eagle Fund Management.
